cim: Krea for Illustrator: Generate Artwork, Vectorize It and Design with Krea Agent
cim_eredeti: Krea for Illustrator: Generate Artwork, Vectorize It and Design with Krea Agent
szoveg_eredeti:
By the Krea Team. Published October 20, 2026.

Krea for Illustrator brings Krea’s image generation into your Illustrator document. Generate artwork, turn it into editable vector paths with Image Trace, explore logo and brand directions, and ask Krea Agent to draw shapes, set type, and arrange layers and artboards.

Generate artwork, trace it to paths, and keep working in the same document.

Yes, in two steps. Krea generates the image, then Illustrator’s Image Trace turns it into editable vector paths. From there they’re ordinary Illustrator paths: recolor, reshape, and scale them with the tools you already use.

That’s faster than drawing every anchor by hand, and you stay in control of the final vectors.

Designing a logo in the browser instead? Read how to create a logo. The Illustrator plugin keeps everything in your .ai file.

Krea for Illustrator runs on macOS 12 or later and Windows 10 or later, with Illustrator 2025 or newer. Generation runs on Krea’s servers, so you need a Krea account and an internet connection.

See all of Krea’s plugins on Krea plugins.

Trace when the deliverable is a logo, an icon, or a mark that has to scale. Keep the raster when it’s a texture or a poster image that doesn’t need anchors.

Generate logo concepts and marks from a prompt or from your selected artwork, then refine the strongest one in the file. You can also send a selection or the active artboard to Krea, edit it, and place the result back exactly where it came from.

That round trip is what makes it work for brand boards: your artboard and the type you’ve already set stay put, and the new mark lands in the same spot.

Ask Krea Agent to draw shapes, set type, arrange layers and artboards, and check its own work, all inside your document. It builds with you, in the file.

Want to try it in the browser first? Open Krea Agent on the web.

Create matching icons, illustrations, and textures that share one style across a project. Generate the first piece, then ask for the rest of the set in the same style: a family of interface icons, a run of chapter illustrations, a texture library for one brand.

For heavier image editing, try Krea 3 on the web. It takes up to 8 reference images per edit and is 10× faster and 3× cheaper than GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana Pro, with fast, high, and ultra modes. See how it ranks in Krea 3 benchmarks.
